scientific_integrity.claim_scope: Exact joint Apéry–Domb residue-pair counts modulo five for every nonnegative digit length and infinite attainability of every supported pair.
limitations: Relies on known classical Lucas congruence mechanisms, reproved directly for this pair.
This specific two-sequence, prime-five enumerative statement may be implicit in earlier general literature.
No extension to prime squares or arbitrary primes is claimed.
Finite executable tests supplement, but do not replace, the proof.

title: Exact joint residue spectrum of Apéry and Domb numbers modulo five
